record.one_liner: Google's AI research notebook (NotebookLM, renamed Gemini Notebook); the documented API is the Enterprise notebook-management API.
record.auth_notes: Enterprise API uses an access token for an authenticated user account (gcloud user credentials), not an OAuth consent flow for third-party apps and not a static API key. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: API methods require an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license assigned to the user; no free or trial path to the API seen. critic: confirmed on re-fetch.
record.api_notes: Fetched page covers notebook management (projects.locations.notebooks REST methods) only; chat, source and studio endpoints not verified.
record.blocker_notes: Official API needs a paid Enterprise license. The consumer product has no official API; community MCP servers drive a browser. critic: search found no official Google NotebookLM MCP (google/mcp issue #19 requests one), so mcp stays community.
